name: org.plantdatabases/askbrassica
title: askBrassica
description: Brassica and canola genes, pangenomes, GWAS, stress expression, paper search, SNPs, germplasm

tools.name: search_data
find_germplasm
tools.description:
Find Brassica genebank accessions by accession number or name: Brassica, Camelina, Sinapis and Raphanus
accessions from GBIF, with the holding genebank (FAO WIEWS code) and accession number; mostly Svalbard Global
Seed Vault safety duplicates. Passport data are minimal (no traits); request seed from the holding genebank.
Also INRAE GnpIS Brassica collections via FAIDARE (B. napus, B. oleracea and B. rapa)
with taxon, holding institute, country of origin, status, pedigree and panels.

tools.name: data_sources
tools.description:
What askBrassica currently indexes: record counts per database and data type, and data versions; plus the live
endpoints it queries or offers (BrAPI nodes, the CropSNPdb genotype API, its own MCP server and JSON API).

tools.name: find_gene
tools.description:
Look up a gene by Ensembl gene ID or gene name/symbol in Ensembl Plants: species, location, assembly, biotype,
description and link. Names are searched in all of: brassica_napus, brassica_rapa (Chiifu), brassica_rapa_ro18 (R-o-18), brassica_rapa_z1 (Z1), brassica_oleracea, brassica_juncea, camelina_sativa, arabidopsis_thaliana (or only in species, if given).
e.g. 'FLC', 'AT5G10140', 'BnaC09g12820D', 'Bra000001'.

tools.name: genes_in_region
tools.description:
Genes overlapping a region of one Ensembl Plants genome (max 5 Mb). species is an Ensembl name, e.g.
'brassica_rapa' (chromosomes A01-A10) or 'brassica_oleracea' (C1-C9); chromosome names as in that assembly. Brassica napus is scaffold-level in Ensembl Plants (Darmor-bzh v4.1), so use B. rapa or B. oleracea for chromosome regions.

tools.name: orthologues
tools.description:
Orthologues of a gene from Ensembl Plants Compara (gene trees across plant genomes), e.g. the Brassica copies
of an Arabidopsis gene. gene: Ensembl ID or name; target_species: Ensembl name to restrict to (e.g.
'brassica_napus'). Returns orthologue IDs, species, relationship (one2one, one2many, many2many).

tools.name: pangenome_gene
tools.description:
Presence/absence of a gene across the accessions of a crop pangenome: how many accessions carry it, core or
variable, which accessions lack it (and which carry it, if fewer), location, description and genome browser link.
gene: a pangenome gene ID, a B. napus Ensembl (Darmor-bzh v4.1: GSBRNA2T..., BnaA01g00010D) or BnIR ZS11 gene ID
(mapped to the pangenome gene), or words from the protein description (e.g. 'flowering locus C') to list matching
genes. B. napus genes come with their Ensembl v4.1 and ZS11 counterparts. Datasets: 'bnapus' = B. napus pangenome (Darmor-bzh v8.1 plus 52 accessions, 94,013 genes; IDs like BnaA01g00010.1D2 for Darmor v8.1 genes and BnaPanG000163 for novel pangenome genes; chromosomes chrA01-chrA10, chrC01-chrC09); 'boleracea' = B. oleracea pangenome (TO1000 reference plus broccoli, Brussels sprouts, cabbage x2, cauliflower x2, kale, kohlrabi and B. macrocarpa; IDs Bo1g001000.1 = Ensembl Plants B. oleracea gene Bo1g001000, novel genes BOLEPAN_00000379.1; chromosomes C1-C9 of the BOL assembly). The dataset is detected from the gene ID, chromosome or accession names when not given. Accessions have a 'form': bnapus Oilseed (24), Synthetic (20, resynthesized from B. rapa x B. oleracea, with parents), Fodder (3), Vegetable (2), Swede (2), Elite (2); boleracea broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, Brussels sprouts, kale, kohlrabi, reference line, wild relative.

tools.name: pangenome_region
tools.description:
Pangenome genes in a region (max 5 Mb) with how many accessions carry each, e.g. to see which genes in a QTL
interval show presence/absence variation. chromosome like 'A01' or 'chrA01'. Datasets: 'bnapus' = B. napus pangenome (Darmor-bzh v8.1 plus 52 accessions, 94,013 genes; IDs like BnaA01g00010.1D2 for Darmor v8.1 genes and BnaPanG000163 for novel pangenome genes; chromosomes chrA01-chrA10, chrC01-chrC09); 'boleracea' = B. oleracea pangenome (TO1000 reference plus broccoli, Brussels sprouts, cabbage x2, cauliflower x2, kale, kohlrabi and B. macrocarpa; IDs Bo1g001000.1 = Ensembl Plants B. oleracea gene Bo1g001000, novel genes BOLEPAN_00000379.1; chromosomes C1-C9 of the BOL assembly). The dataset is detected from the gene ID, chromosome or accession names when not given. Accessions have a 'form': bnapus Oilseed (24), Synthetic (20, resynthesized from B. rapa x B. oleracea, with parents), Fodder (3), Vegetable (2), Swede (2), Elite (2); boleracea broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, Brussels sprouts, kale, kohlrabi, reference line, wild relative.

tools.name: pangenome_compare
tools.description:
Genes whose presence frequency differs most between two groups of pangenome accessions (accession names from
pangenome_accessions, 'form:<form>' selectors such as 'form:Synthetic' or 'form:cauliflower', or ['all']).
min_diff is the minimum absolute frequency difference (0-1);
positive diff = more frequent in group_a. Datasets: 'bnapus' = B. napus pangenome (Darmor-bzh v8.1 plus 52 accessions, 94,013 genes; IDs like BnaA01g00010.1D2 for Darmor v8.1 genes and BnaPanG000163 for novel pangenome genes; chromosomes chrA01-chrA10, chrC01-chrC09); 'boleracea' = B. oleracea pangenome (TO1000 reference plus broccoli, Brussels sprouts, cabbage x2, cauliflower x2, kale, kohlrabi and B. macrocarpa; IDs Bo1g001000.1 = Ensembl Plants B. oleracea gene Bo1g001000, novel genes BOLEPAN_00000379.1; chromosomes C1-C9 of the BOL assembly). The dataset is detected from the gene ID, chromosome or accession names when not given. Accessions have a 'form': bnapus Oilseed (24), Synthetic (20, resynthesized from B. rapa x B. oleracea, with parents), Fodder (3), Vegetable (2), Swede (2), Elite (2); boleracea broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, Brussels sprouts, kale, kohlrabi, reference line, wild relative.

tools.name: pangenome_accessions
tools.description:
Accessions in a crop pangenome with their metadata (form, genotype code, synthetic parents where known) and the
number of genes each carries and lacks. dataset defaults to the first one. Datasets: 'bnapus' = B. napus pangenome (Darmor-bzh v8.1 plus 52 accessions, 94,013 genes; IDs like BnaA01g00010.1D2 for Darmor v8.1 genes and BnaPanG000163 for novel pangenome genes; chromosomes chrA01-chrA10, chrC01-chrC09); 'boleracea' = B. oleracea pangenome (TO1000 reference plus broccoli, Brussels sprouts, cabbage x2, cauliflower x2, kale, kohlrabi and B. macrocarpa; IDs Bo1g001000.1 = Ensembl Plants B. oleracea gene Bo1g001000, novel genes BOLEPAN_00000379.1; chromosomes C1-C9 of the BOL assembly). The dataset is detected from the gene ID, chromosome or accession names when not given. Accessions have a 'form': bnapus Oilseed (24), Synthetic (20, resynthesized from B. rapa x B. oleracea, with parents), Fodder (3), Vegetable (2), Swede (2), Elite (2); boleracea broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, Brussels sprouts, kale, kohlrabi, reference line, wild relative.

tools.name: arabidopsis_function
tools.description:
Function of a gene through its Arabidopsis thaliana orthologue(s): Ensembl Plants Compara orthologues, then
UniProtKB curated function, protein and gene names, mutant (disruption) phenotype, subcellular location and GO
terms, plus TAIR curation: symbol, full name, curator summary, GO terms with experimental evidence (with PubMed
IDs), mutant phenotypes of germplasm lines and the number of papers on the gene. gene: an Ensembl gene ID or name of any crop genome here, or an AGI (AT5G10140) / Arabidopsis name (FLC);
in askBrassica also a B. napus pangenome gene (BnaA01g00010.1D2, BnaPanG...).
one2many / many2many orthologues are all listed; the crop gene's own function is inferred, not shown.

tools.name: coexpressed_genes
tools.description:
Genes co-expressed with a gene, for guessing function and shortlisting candidates (e.g. under a QTL), from
ATTED-II union co-expression (thousands of RNA-seq samples per species; z-score, higher = stronger). For a crop
gene the Arabidopsis orthologue's co-expressed genes are listed, each with its TAIR symbol and description and its
orthologues back in the crop species; soybean genes (GLYMA_...) use soybean's own co-expression where loaded.
gene: an Ensembl gene ID or name of a crop genome here, or an AGI / Arabidopsis name. agi: choose which Arabidopsis
orthologue to use when there are several (default: the first). top: number of partners (max 50).
Co-expression across Arabidopsis samples is evidence about the Arabidopsis gene; the crop copies may differ.

tools.name: resistance_loci
tools.description:
Curated resistance loci of Brassica crops: blackleg (Leptosphaeria maculans: Rlm1-Rlm14, LepR1-3, RlmS),
clubroot (Plasmodiophora brassicae: CRa, CRb, Crr1-5, Rcr1-10, PbBa...), and in Brassica vegetables downy mildew
(BraDM, Pp523, BoDMR2...), Fusarium yellows (FocBo1, Foc-Br1), black rot (Xca1bo, XccBo, BRQTL...), turnip mosaic
virus (retr01, retr02, ConTR01, TuRB01b, TuRB07...), Sclerotinia, soft rot and white rust QTL: source species and genotype,
chromosome, pathotypes (clubroot), whether cloned, gene class and the Darmor-bzh v4.1 gene for cloned blackleg
genes (Rlm2/LepR3 BnaA10g20720D; Rlm4/Rlm7/Rlm9 BnaA07g20220D), with references. query: a locus name or part
('Rlm', 'Crr', 'LepR3', 'TuRB'); disease: 'blackleg', 'clubroot', 'downy mildew', 'fusarium', 'black rot', 'TuMV',
'sclerotinia', 'soft rot', 'white rust'; chromosome: 'A07', 'C03', 'B04'.

tools.name: resistance_gene_analogues
tools.description:
Resistance gene analogues (RGAs) in the B. napus pangenome (1,749 genes: NBS-LRR classes TNL, CNL, RNL, NL, TN,
CN, RN, NBS, TX; receptor-like kinases RLK; receptor-like proteins RLP), with presence/absence across the 53
pangenome accessions, description and location (Darmor-bzh v8.1 with pangenome contigs). Filter by chromosome
('A10'; with start/end in bp for a region), a pangenome gene ID, rga_class ('NLR' for all NBS-LRR classes, or
'TNL', 'RLK', 'RLP'...) and variable_only (genes absent from some accessions).

tools.name: bnir_gwas
tools.description:
Genome-wide association peaks for B. napus traits from BnIR (HZAU): 135 traits from 10 GWAS studies (seed oil
fatty acids and erucic acid, glucosinolates, oil content, flowering time, plant height, branching, silique and seed
traits, cadmium, salt and other stress responses...). Each peak (adjacent 500-kb windows with p <= 1e-6) gives the
study, lead SNP with alleles, consequence, p-value, effect (beta) and variance explained, and the genes within 25 kb
of the lead SNP with their Arabidopsis best hit and Darmor-bzh v4.1 ID (= Ensembl Plants B. napus). Search by trait
words ('erucic', 'flowering'), a ZS11 region (chromosome 'A08' with start/end in bp), or gene (ZS11
BnaA08G0133900ZS, Darmor v4.1 BnaA08g11040D, Arabidopsis AGI or name such as FAE1). No arguments lists the traits.

tools.name: bnir_expression
tools.description:
B. napus (ZS11) RNA-seq expression in TPM from BnIR: 'stress' (leaf and root time courses, 0.25-24 h, under
salt, drought, osmotic, heat, cold 4 C and freezing -4 C, with controls at the same time points), 'hormone' (leaf
and root, IAA, ACC, GA, ABA, trans-zeatin, JA, brassinolide) or 'tissue' (BnTIR: 91 libraries of bud, flower,
leaf, stem, root, silique and seed stages). gene: ZS11 ID (BnaA02G0156900ZS), Darmor-bzh v4.1 name, pangenome ID,
or a name/AGI (FLC, AT5G10140: all B. napus copies). Filter by treatment ('salt', 'cold') or tissue ('root').
Stress/hormone rows give each time point with the control at the same tissue and time.

tools.name: expression_experiments
tools.description:
Brassica RNA-seq experiments held by askBrassica (Expression Atlas, SRA study SRP159041 (B. napus leaf cold, heat and drought; quantified by askBrassica) and 69 B. napus SRA projects from BrassicaEDB (abiotic and biotic stress, chemical treatments, development, genotypes; experiment IDs PRJNA...)): baseline (TPM by
tissue / developmental stage / treatment) and differential (stress, pathogen, genotype contrasts). query filters descriptions/labels (e.g. 'drought',
'grain', 'Fusarium'). Gives each experiment's assay groups (baseline) or contrasts (differential).

tools.name: gene_expression
tools.description:
Where and when a Brassica gene is expressed, and under which treatments it changes, from Expression Atlas, SRA study SRP159041 (B. napus leaf cold, heat and drought; quantified by askBrassica) and 69 B. napus SRA projects from BrassicaEDB (abiotic and biotic stress, chemical treatments, development, genotypes; experiment IDs PRJNA...).
gene: Ensembl gene ID (e.g. GSBRNA2T00000001001 for B. napus, Bra000001 for B. rapa) or a gene name find_gene resolves. Baseline: TPM (median over replicates,
with range) for the top_groups highest-expressed tissues/stages per experiment. Differential: every contrast where
the gene is significant (adjusted p < 0.05, |log2FC| >= 1). experiment restricts to one accession; otherwise the
max_experiments baseline experiments with the highest TPM are detailed and the rest listed with their maximum.

tools.name: expression_genes
tools.description:
Genes characteristic of a tissue/stage or responsive to a treatment in one Expression Atlas experiment.
Baseline experiment + group (text matched to group labels, e.g. 'root', 'grain'): genes with TPM >= min_tpm in a
matching group ranked by specificity = (max TPM in matching groups + 1) / (max TPM in other groups + 1).
Differential experiment + contrast (text matched to contrast names or IDs): significant genes, direction 'up' or
'down', ranked by |log2FC|. Use expression_experiments() for group and contrast names.

tools.name: gene_in_assemblies
tools.description:
Corresponding genes of a Brassica gene in other genome assemblies: 32 Brassica assemblies distributed by BnaOmics: B. napus Darmor-bzh v10, Express 617, NY7, the eight HZAU genomes (Gangan, Zheyou 73, Shengli, Tapidor, Quinta, Westar, No2127; ZS11 is the BnIR genome) and the HZAU pan-genome reference, ZS11, Westar and Laurentian ONT assemblies, ZS4-2, ZS9, HTR001, Zhongyou 821 and ZS11 (FAFU); B. carinata zd-1; B. juncea AU213 and tumida v2; B. nigra YZ12151, Ni100 v2, C2; B. oleracea HDEM, JZS v2, Korso, OX-heart; B. rapa Chiifu v3.0 and v2.5, Z1 v2 (assembly ids like Bnapus_Darmor_v10, Bnapus_Westar_ONT, Brapa_Chiifu_v3; B. napus genes are matched to Ensembl Darmor v4.1, B. rapa to Chiifu, B. oleracea to TO1000, B. juncea and B. nigra to Ensembl B. juncea, B. carinata to B. juncea + B. oleracea); plus from BRAD (brassicadb.cn): the B. rapa pan-genome of Cai et al. 2021 (16 assemblies, ids Brapa_pan_<code>: CCA/CCB Chinese cabbage, CXA/CXB caixin, OIA oilseed, OIB/OIC rapid cycling, TUA/TUE turnip, PCA/PCB pak choi, WTC wutacai, TCA taicai, BRO broccoletto, MIZ mizuna, TBA Tibet), B. rapa Chiifu v4.1 (Brapa_Chiifu_v41) and pak choi (Brapa_PakChoi), radish Xiang (Rsativus_Xiang) and 15 wild Brassicaceae (Aethionema arabicum, Arabis alpina, A. halleri Tada, A. lyrata v2.1, Boechera retrofracta and stricta, Capsella grandiflora and rubella, Cardamine hirsuta, Descurainia sophia, Isatis indigotica, Leavenworthia alabamica, Sisymbrium irio, Thellungiella halophila, Thlaspi arvense; matched to Arabidopsis). gene: an Ensembl Plants gene
ID or name ('BnaC09g12820D', 'GSBRNA2T00000001001', 'Bra000001', 'Bo1g001000') or a gene ID of one of these assemblies (returns its Ensembl match, then the
other assemblies). Matches are DIAMOND best protein hits to the Ensembl gene (identity, query coverage, and
whether the pair is a reciprocal best hit); each gene has its location and a genome browser link. assembly
restricts to one assembly id; reciprocal_only keeps reciprocal best hits.

tools.name: assembly_genes_in_region
tools.description:
Genes in a region of one of the extra Brassica assemblies (32 Brassica assemblies distributed by BnaOmics: B. napus Darmor-bzh v10, Express 617, NY7, the eight HZAU genomes (Gangan, Zheyou 73, Shengli, Tapidor, Quinta, Westar, No2127; ZS11 is the BnIR genome) and the HZAU pan-genome reference, ZS11, Westar and Laurentian ONT assemblies, ZS4-2, ZS9, HTR001, Zhongyou 821 and ZS11 (FAFU); B. carinata zd-1; B. juncea AU213 and tumida v2; B. nigra YZ12151, Ni100 v2, C2; B. oleracea HDEM, JZS v2, Korso, OX-heart; B. rapa Chiifu v3.0 and v2.5, Z1 v2 (assembly ids like Bnapus_Darmor_v10, Bnapus_Westar_ONT, Brapa_Chiifu_v3; B. napus genes are matched to Ensembl Darmor v4.1, B. rapa to Chiifu, B. oleracea to TO1000, B. juncea and B. nigra to Ensembl B. juncea, B. carinata to B. juncea + B. oleracea); plus from BRAD (brassicadb.cn): the B. rapa pan-genome of Cai et al. 2021 (16 assemblies, ids Brapa_pan_<code>: CCA/CCB Chinese cabbage, CXA/CXB caixin, OIA oilseed, OIB/OIC rapid cycling, TUA/TUE turnip, PCA/PCB pak choi, WTC wutacai, TCA taicai, BRO broccoletto, MIZ mizuna, TBA Tibet), B. rapa Chiifu v4.1 (Brapa_Chiifu_v41) and pak choi (Brapa_PakChoi), radish Xiang (Rsativus_Xiang) and 15 wild Brassicaceae (Aethionema arabicum, Arabis alpina, A. halleri Tada, A. lyrata v2.1, Boechera retrofracta and stricta, Capsella grandiflora and rubella, Cardamine hirsuta, Descurainia sophia, Isatis indigotica, Leavenworthia alabamica, Sisymbrium irio, Thellungiella halophila, Thlaspi arvense; matched to Arabidopsis)) with their best Ensembl Plants match,
e.g. to list candidates under a QTL or SV mapped on that assembly. assembly: assembly id; chrom as named in that
assembly; at most 2 Mb.

tools.name: brad_syntenic_orthologues
tools.description:
Syntenic orthologues of a gene across Brassicaceae genomes from BRAD, split by the Brassiceae whole-genome
triplication subgenomes: LF (least fractionated), MF1 and MF2 (more fractionated). Ensembl Compara gives
orthologues but not this subgenome assignment or synteny support. gene: an Arabidopsis AGI or symbol (AT5G10140,
FLC) or a gene ID of one of BRAD's genomes (e.g. B. rapa Chiifu v3.0 BraA10g027720.3C, v1.5 Bra009055).
genomes: BRAD genome codes; default Ath10 (TAIR10), Brapa30 / Brapa40 (B. rapa Chiifu v3.0 / v4.0), BrapaPak
(pak choi), BOL20 (B. oleracea JZS v2.0), Bni20 (B. nigra Ni100 v2), BnaDARMOR_BZHV10_A / _C (B. napus Darmor v10
A and C subgenomes), BjuT84V2_AA / _BB (B. juncea T84 v2), Rsa10 (radish), Csa10 (Camelina); 'all' for all 53
(slow: about 5-10 s per genome, 4 in parallel). Per genome and subgenome: the syntenic gene, tandem copies, and
for B. rapa the BLAST e-value and flanking-gene synteny support (e.g. '17|20' = 17 of 20 flanking genes).

tools.name: brad_gene_variants
tools.description:
SNPs of a gene across a BRAD diversity panel (live from BRAD; the first query of a gene can take up to a
minute), with each SNP's alleles and alternative-allele frequency and the accessions grouped into haplotypes.
Panels, chosen from the gene ID: B. rapa 524 accessions (Chiifu v3.0 IDs, BraA06g029970.3C; Cai et al. 2021
Genome Biol doi:10.1186/s13059-021-02383-2), B. rapa 199 accessions (v1.5 IDs = Ensembl Bra019255), B. oleracea
119 accessions (JZS v2.0 BolC07g051080.2J or v1.1 Bol042142), B. napus 608 accessions (Darmor v5 = Ensembl v4.1
names, BnaA01g13580D), B. juncea 187 accessions (T84 v2.0 BjuVA01G15790). Use gene_in_assemblies or
brad_syntenic_orthologues to get the right ID. For allele frequencies between morphotypes (B. rapa) or ecotypes
(B. napus winter/spring) use brad_snp_group_test.

tools.name: brad_snp_group_test
tools.description:
Allele and genotype counts of one SNP in two groups of a BRAD panel with BRAD's chi-square test. snp: as
returned by brad_gene_variants ('A06_20735735' for B. rapa, 'chrA01_6907497' for B. napus). group1 / group2:
B. rapa 524 panel morphotypes 'Sarson Type', 'Japanese Type', 'Oil Type', 'Asian Turnip', 'Chinese Cabbage',
'Taicai', 'Pak Choi', 'Caixin', 'European Turnip', 'Others'; B. napus 608 panel (panel=
'Brana_Dar_V5_608_accessions') 'Winter', 'Semi-Winter-1', 'Semi-Winter-2', 'Spring'.

tools.name: brad_rapa_mutants
tools.description:
B. rapa B9008 EMS mutant library lines (Chinese cabbage line CCA) carrying mutations in a gene, from BRAD.
gene: a B. rapa Chiifu ID (v1.5 Bra009055, v3.0 BraA10g027720.3C, v3.1, v3.5) or a CCA gene (A10p27960.1_BraCCA).
mutation_types: default stop_gained and missense_variant (also splice_acceptor_variant, splice_donor_variant,
start_lost, stop_lost, synonymous_variant). details adds the position and amino-acid change per line (first 20
lines). Seed requests go to the BRAD team (Institute of Vegetables and Flowers, CAAS).

tools.name: brad_rapa_expression
tools.description:
B. rapa expression (TPM) from BRAD's eFP datasets: leaf development (shoot apical meristem SAM and leaves
L1-L9, regions R1-R5) and leaf mesophyll / vascular cell types (spongy, palisade, bundle sheath, epidermis, guard
cells, phloem and xylem cell types). gene: a B. rapa Chiifu v3.0 ID (BraA10g027720.3C); for Ensembl Bra IDs or
names find the v3.0 ID with brad_syntenic_orthologues or gene_in_assemblies.

tools.name: brad_gene_sets
tools.description:
Curated B. rapa gene sets from BRAD with their Arabidopsis counterparts and references: flowering (141),
glucosinolate (111), anthocyanin (82), auxin (343), resistance (NBS-LRR, 245) and transcription factors (by
family). B. rapa IDs are Chiifu v1.5 (= Ensembl Plants B. rapa, Bra000001). category: one of flowering,
glucosinolate, anthocyanin, auxin, resistance, transcription_factor; query: words matched to symbol, family and
annotation (e.g. 'FLC', 'MYB28', 'TIR-NBS-LRR', 'MADS'); gene: a Bra or AT ID. No arguments: counts.

tools.name: snp_lines
tools.description:
Find SNP-genotyped lines in CropSNPdb by name or accession (e.g. 'Westar', 'Darmor').
Returns line name, accession(s), country, pedigree, status, breeding organisation and donor. dataset: 'Brassica napus Darmor v81' (default, 459 lines), 'Brassica napus Darmor v41', 'Brassica rapa v3', 'Brassica oleracea v2.1', 'Brassica juncea v1.5' (all Brassica 60K array); 'bnapus_pangenome' (53 B. napus pangenome accessions, 1.36 M WGS SNPs, Darmor v8.1 chromosomes A01-C09; keep regions small for genotypes).

tools.name: snp_genotypes
tools.description:
SNP genotype calls for up to 50 lines in a region (chromosome like 'A01'). Returns markers with positions
and each line's call. Keep regions small (a few Mb) for many lines.

tools.name: snp_compare_lines
tools.description:
Compare two lines' SNP genotypes on a chromosome (optionally a region): markers compared, identical,
different, % identity and the regions where they differ (useful for pedigree/introgression questions).

tools.name: snp_haplotype_carriers
tools.description:
Lines that share a reference line's SNP haplotype in a region (max 5 Mb), e.g. which genebank lines carry the
Westar haplotype around a gene. Only markers polymorphic in the panel (minor allele frequency >= min_maf) are
used, and a match needs calls at >= min_called of them with at most max_mismatch differences. Always report
informative_markers and fraction_matching; if 'note' says the haplotype is common, say it is not diagnostic.

tools.name: snp_markers
tools.description: SNP markers (IDs and positions) of a CropSNPdb dataset in a region, with the total count.

tools.name: snp_phenotypes
tools.description:
Field trial trait data held in CropSNPdb for this crop (Australian Grains Genebank and other Brassica trial records). With no arguments, lists the
available traits. Filter by line and/or trait: trait matches the
exact name or any part of it (e.g. 'Height', 'grain yield'). Most phenotyped lines are in the
Brassica napus Darmor v81 dataset.

tools.name: gwas_associations
tools.description:
Published GWAS marker-trait associations curated by GWAS Atlas (CNCB-NGDC), each with its position, trait
(Plant Trait Ontology), p-value, R2, population and paper (PMID). Data here: Brassica napus (3,568 associations from 38 papers) on NCBI Bra_napus_v2.0 (Darmor-bzh; RefSeq chromosomes NC_027757-75 = A01-C09 per the NCBI assembly report), with the nearest Ensembl Darmor v4.1 gene placed on v2.0 by cDNA alignment (70,051 of 101,040 genes). trait: words
('plant height', 'stripe rust', 'grain yield'); region: 'chromosome:start-end' on the stated assembly (e.g.
'6A:8-9Mb'); gene: a gene ID or symbol, giving associations within window_kb of it; species: limit to one species
(Ensembl name; default all, 'all' for every species); max_p: keep p-values at or below this. Results are sorted by p-value; by_trait and by_paper
summarise all matches.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description:
Search publications and preprints in Europe PMC (PubMed, PMC, bioRxiv and others).

query: free text or Europe PMC syntax (e.g. 'grain size QTL 6A', 'TITLE:"pan-genome"').
gene: optional gene name or Ensembl ID; its curated synonyms and RefSeq IDs are OR-ed into the query
(e.g. gene='FLC' or gene='BnaC09g12820D').
Words are matched in title and abstract; full_text=True also searches open-access full text.
crop_only requires Brassica/canola/rapeseed/Camelina in title or abstract. sort: 'relevance', 'date' (newest first) or 'cited'.
Returns hit count and papers with DOI/PMID, year, journal, open-access flag, citations and a short abstract.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description:
Full record for one paper: DOI (10.xxxx/..), PMID (digits) or PMCID (PMC...). Returns the abstract,
open-access status and full-text links.

tools.name: literature_gene_traits
tools.description:
Genes and Plant Trait Ontology terms mentioned together in open-access full-text papers (found with Europe PMC,
text from PubMed Central), mined by askCrop: in the same sentence (level 'sentence', stronger) or the same paragraph
of at most three genes (level 'paragraph'); tables and references are skipped. gene: a gene ID (or wheat symbol) gives the papers that name it and the traits it co-occurs with,
with example sentences; trait: words ('grain size', 'drought', 'flowering time') gives the genes most often named
alongside it. A co-mention is text evidence to read, not a demonstrated gene function: check the sentence and
paper. Each paper carries its licence: quote verbatim with citation, and summarise rather than reword quotes from
ND-licensed papers. Only papers whose full text is open access are covered.

tools.name: paper_qtl
tools.description:
QTL and marker-trait associations read from the tables of open-access Brassica papers (PubMed Central full
text, mostly 2015 onwards). Complements GWAS Atlas and BnIR (GWAS only) with QTL mapping and GWAS tables. Search by trait words (matched in the table's trait column and caption),
chromosome ('A09', 'C03'), region ('A09:20-30Mb' on the assembly the paper used); species ('napus', 'rapa', 'oleracea', 'juncea') from the paper title or table caption. Each row gives the
trait, QTL name, marker, chromosome, the position as reported (assembly as stated in the paper), cM, LOD, p, PVE,
the table caption and the paper with its licence. Positions are as reported, on whatever assembly the paper used (Darmor-bzh v4.1 or v10, ZS11, Chiifu, TO1000...): do not compare them across papers without checking. Tables were parsed automatically: check a
surprising row in the paper.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description:
Find open-access full-text papers that answer a question, by meaning as well as keywords (e.g. 'what limits
grain filling under heat stress', 'genes controlling spike architecture'). Combines vector search
(BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings) and keyword search, ranked by reciprocal rank fusion, and groups the hits by
paper: limit counts papers (default 10, max 50), each with its best passages (passages_per_paper 1-3) and section.
papers_matching_keywords tells you how many papers share the question's words: if it is much larger than what
you have, page with offset or narrow with year_from/year_to or a more specific question. Read a whole paper with
get_paper. Quote passages verbatim and cite the paper; summarise rather than reword quotes from no-derivatives
(ND) papers. Covers only open-access papers in PubMed Central; methods sections are not indexed.

tools.name: protein_structure
tools.description:
Predicted 3D structure of a gene's protein: its UniProtKB accession(s) (Ensembl Plants protein matches) and the
AlphaFold Protein Structure Database model for each, with mean pLDDT confidence and the fraction of residues in
each confidence band, plus viewer and file links. gene: symbol or Ensembl/IWGSC ID. Useful for judging whether a
coding variant or edit falls in a confidently folded domain. Cite AlphaFold DB (Varadi et al. 2024, Nucleic
Acids Res, doi:10.1093/nar/gkad1011) and UniProt.

tools.name: brapi_germplasm_studies
tools.description:
Phenotyping studies (field and glasshouse trials) with trait data for a Brassica line, live from the BrAPI nodes
(currently the INRAE Brassica trials in GnpIS (rapeseed and cabbage collections), served through FAIDARE). germplasm: a cultivar or line name (matched exactly; upper/title case are tried too, e.g.
'Soissons' -> 'SOISSONS'). Returns the matching germplasm records (source, holding institute, accession) and each
study's name, trial/network, season, location, number of observations, variables measured and link. Use
brapi_observations for the trait values.

tools.name: brapi_observations
tools.description:
Trait observations for a Brassica line from the BrAPI nodes (currently the INRAE Brassica trials in GnpIS (rapeseed and cabbage collections), served through FAIDARE), summarised per study and variable:
n, mean, min, max (numeric values) or the distinct values, season and location. germplasm: line name (as in
brapi_germplasm_studies). trait filters variables by name or ontology ID part (e.g. 'rdt', 'CO_321:1000074',
'yield'; INRAE short names are glossed: rdt = grain yield, prot = grain protein, pmg = thousand-grain weight, ht
= plant height, rj/rb = yellow/brown rust). study filters by study name part (e.g. 'Le_Moulon', '2015').
Compare values within a study.

tools.name: gene_pathways
tools.description:
Plant Reactome metabolic and signalling pathways of a gene (Gramene), with the top-level category and a link
to the pathway diagram. gene: an Ensembl Plants gene ID or a gene name/symbol. Pathways are projected from rice
by orthology, so say they are inferred. Use pathway_genes for the reverse (all genes of a pathway).

tools.name: pathway_genes
tools.description:
Genes in a Plant Reactome pathway: pathway is a name or words from it ('jasmonic acid biosynthesis',
'gibberellin', 'flavonoid') or a stable ID (R-TAE-1119332). species: a species name as Plant Reactome writes it
('Triticum aestivum', 'Brassica napus', 'Glycine max'); default all species loaded for this site. Matching pathways
are listed with their genes per species. Membership is projected from rice by orthology.

tools.name: trait_hits
tools.description:
Trait-associated positions across the genome for a chromosome overview: GWAS marker-trait associations and
peaks, named trait genes and mapped trait loci held by this site, with chromosome sizes, each with a genome browser
link where the assembly is loaded. trait: words to match (e.g. 'height', 'oil', 'alkaloid'); chromosome filters
one chromosome. Map marker tracks are left out unless a chromosome is given. Tracks with karyotype false are on
another assembly than chromosome_sizes (pulse: soybean and common bean, Ensembl chromosome numbers; faba bean on
Hedin/2 v2 and projected v1; lentil CDC Redberry v2).

tools.name: genes_with_annotation
tools.description:
Find genes by function: GO term, InterPro or Pfam domain (accession or words, e.g. 'NB-ARC', 'IPR002182',
'GO:0009414', 'disease resistance', 'MADS-box') or Plant Reactome pathway ('gibberellin biosynthesis',
R-TAE-...; kind='pathway'). kind: GO, InterPro, Pfam or pathway (default: GO + InterPro + Pfam). Optional species
(Ensembl name) and region (chromosome, start, end in bp on the Ensembl/RefSeq v1.0 assembly) filters, e.g. all
NLR genes in a QTL interval. Returns matching genes with location, matched terms and genome browser link, plus
facet counts by species, chromosome and term. Annotations are electronic (InterProScan, GO from InterPro2GO).

tools.name: gene_neighbourhood
tools.description:
Gene neighbourhood (microsynteny): the gene and its flanking genes, with their orthologues in related genomes
(B. napus, B. rapa R-o-18, B. oleracea, Camelina, Arabidopsis) from Ensembl Compara. For each target genome, the collinear block holding most
orthologues of the neighbourhood is reported with how many neighbours are conserved there, so a candidate gene can
be checked for a conserved genomic context. flank: genes each side (default 8, max 25). targets: Ensembl genome
names (default ['brassica_napus', 'brassica_rapa_ro18', 'brassica_oleracea', 'camelina_sativa', 'arabidopsis_thaliana']).

tools.name: gene_papers
tools.description:
Papers mentioning a gene: Europe PMC search for its gene IDs (all versions, in open-access full text) and its
name/symbols (in title or abstract, with Brassica/canola/rapeseed/Camelina). Each paper says whether it matched an ID or a
name. Name matches can be another gene with the same symbol: check the abstract.

tools.name: annotate_genes
tools.description:
Annotate a list of genes (up to 500 IDs or names) in one call: resolved ID, species, location, name, top
InterPro/Pfam domains, GO terms, Plant Reactome pathways and orthologues in the main related genomes
(['brassica_napus', 'brassica_rapa_ro18', 'brassica_oleracea', 'camelina_sativa', 'arabidopsis_thaliana']). For gene-list follow-up after an experiment (DE genes, GWAS candidates); the web
page genes.html (gene-list tab) runs this and downloads a TSV.

tools.name: blast_sequence
tools.description:
BLAST a DNA or protein sequence (raw or FASTA; up to 20 kb DNA or 5,000 aa) against this site's databases:
B. napus Darmor-bzh v4.1 and ZS11, B. oleracea TO1000 and B. rapa Chiifu genomes; CDS and proteins of the three Ensembl genomes. The program is chosen from the query and database types (blastn, or blastn-short under 50 nt;
blastx; blastp; tblastn against CDS only). databases: ids from the list this tool returns (default: DNA query ->
reference genome + all CDS sets; protein -> all protein sets). Hits give gene ID (CDS/protein) or genome position
with overlapping genes, identity, alignment length, e-value and a genome browser link. People can use the
SequenceServer page at /blast/ for the same databases.

tools.name: brassica_gene_view
tools.description: Interactive gene view for one Brassica gene: a relationship map of its orthologues in B. rapa, B. oleracea, B. juncea, Camelina and Arabidopsis, Arabidopsis function, presence/absence across the B. napus (53 accessions) or B. oleracea (10) pangenome by crop form, BnIR stress responses (ZS11 copies), Expression Atlas contrasts and recent papers, with tabs for pangenome presence by form, a BnIR stress time-course heatmap and baseline expression. Clients that support MCP Apps show it in the chat; the result also lists the nodes, the panel data and the gene page link (page) to share. gene: gene name or Ensembl/LIS ID.

tools.name: genesys_accession
tools.description:
Genebank accessions from Genesys (Crop Trust), live: full passport data (holder, accession number and names,
taxon, biological status, country and site of origin, coordinates, pedigree), whether the accession is available,
in the Multilateral System (SMTA) and safety-duplicated in Svalbard, whether the holder takes requests through
Genesys, a DOI where assigned, and the climate at the collection site (WorldClim: mean temperature, temperature
extremes, precipitation). accession: accession number (e.g. 'PI 591780', 'IG 32990'); holder: FAO WIEWS code
(e.g. USA029, LBN002, AUS165) to make it unique; name: free text (e.g. 'Chinese Spring') when the number is not
known; crop: Genesys crop code (wheat, barley, chickpea, lentil, pea ...) to narrow a name search.

tools.name: panel_haplotypes
tools.description:
SNP haplotypes of a gene across a diversity panel: accessions grouped by their SNP alleles in the gene
+-2 kb (MAF >= 0.02, <= 20% missing), each haplotype with size, number of alternative alleles, whether it is
reference-like and its accessions, plus the SNPs (position, alleles, frequency). Panels: 'napus289_A' = A subgenome (A01-A10) SNPs of 289 B. napus accessions plus 199 B. rapa; 'napus289_C' = C subgenome (C01-C09) SNPs of 289 B. napus plus B. oleracea accessions; both on the ZS11 assembly (BRAD napus289 dataset). Sample names are the VCF codes: SamA_ (199, B. rapa in the A file), SamC_ and Bol (B. oleracea and C-genome relatives), Bni (2, B. nigra outgroup), R, Bna and _GSS (B. napus). The VCF is a PLINK export whose REF allele is provisional (often the major allele, about 10% differ from ZS11), so 'reference-like' haplotypes mean major-allele-like here.
gene: an Ensembl B. napus gene (BnaA10g22080D, GSBRNA2T...) or a ZS11 gene ID (BnaA10G0000100ZS); Ensembl genes are matched to ZS11 genes through the DIAMOND best matches of gene_in_assemblies (HZAU pan-genome reference)
